stem: How does the inference supported by paragraphs 2 through 4 from the excerpt from "Music and the Maestro" DIFFER from the inference supported by paragraphs 8 through 10 from the story "Saturday Surprise"?

options.label: A
options.text: Paragraphs 2 through 4 from the excerpt support the inference that mentors look for ways to improve themselves, whereas paragraphs 8 through 10 from the story support the inference that mentors feel content with their current skill level.

options.label: B
options.text: Paragraphs 2 through 4 from the excerpt support the inference that professionals work hard to succeed, whereas paragraphs 8 through 10 from the story support the inference that success comes naturally to some professionals.

options.label: C
options.text: Paragraphs 2 through 4 from the excerpt support the inference that leading others is best achieved in a relaxed environment, whereas paragraphs 8 through 10 from the story support the inference that leading others can occur in a competitive environment.

options.label: D
options.text: Paragraphs 2 through 4 from the excerpt support the inference that teaching others requires commitment, whereas paragraphs 8 through 10 from the story support the inference that teaching others can occur spontaneously.
